description: Data and scripts underlying the publication: “Flood Risk Assessment of Urban Critical Infrastructures using Crowd-Sourced and Open Data on Hazard, Exposure and Vulnerability" for Case Study Rotterdam is a data set deposited in 4TU.ResearchData by its authors Andreas Burzel. Spatial data and Python script of the Rotterdam case study for the open access publication "Flood Risk Assessment of Urban Critical Infrastructures using Crowd-Sourced and Open Data on Hazard, Exposure and Vulnerability". Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. Formats: CSV. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support multi-sector infrastructure risk and planning studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-4tu-repository.
